integrity: All claims are based on an analytical all-order proof and source-specific semantic comparisons. Independent scientific validation has not been performed. Previously unindexed equivalent results remain a bibliographic possibility.
scientific_limitations: Only a Parseval frame of three consecutive cyclic Fourier rows, three distinct erased columns, and integer orders at least six; no statement about larger erasures, other bands, optimal decoder design, or arbitrary weights. Numerical checks cover only N=6..48.
title: Sharp three-erasure stability of three-frequency cyclic harmonic frames
